FA-01_incident_false_positive_rate.caveat: only 7 incidents were raised on TEST (2 blockage-seed runs, 6 measured physical blockages plus queue episodes): the interval is wide ([0.0, 0.354]) and 0% should be read as 'no false positives observed on a small sample', not as a tight bound.
FA-01_incident_false_positive_rate.target: <= 10% of raised incidents, counted after correlation/deduplication

FA-02_data_quality_incident_false_positi.reason: no data-quality incident detector exists yet - P10.07 ('Correlate platform signals into incidents') builds it from OpenTelemetry/health signals (P10.01-P10.06). P03.06's fault catalog (7 types, byte-identical ground truth, source-code/simulator/faults/) is ready as that stage's held-out set; it is unused here because using it now would mean inventing a detector to satisfy the metric.

LAT-03_candidate_to_incident_latency.caveat: measured for event-driven correlation (sync() called per new/changed candidate). The Part-A replay in verify_incidents.py polls every 5 minutes for demonstration convenience and would itself violate this target - deployment MUST trigger sync() on candidate write, not on a timer.
LAT-03_candidate_to_incident_latency.target: P95 < 5 s, last contributing evidence event to incident record creation, nominal load

test.note: last contributing evidence event's observation_time to incident opened_at; event-driven correlation (no polling delay), nominal load

SAFE-03_stale_state_triggers_fail_safe.gap: No dependent service currently reads freshness_status and refuses to act on it - that gate belongs to P07.05's command execution policy ('fresh state' check) and P07's route/recommendation consumers. SAFE-03 cannot be closed here; it is carried to P07.05/P07.09 and P12.02's fault-injection suite.
SAFE-03_stale_state_triggers_fail_safe.measured: P05.06/P05.07 (verify_network_state.py, verify_api.py) prove freshness_status flips to 'stale' past the staleness budget and the API reports it correctly.
SAFE-03_stale_state_triggers_fail_safe.status: partially measurable now, not yet enforced

overlay_kinds_note: collision/wrong_way/flooding/low_visibility are specification-tested (P06.05), not scenario-scored: 216/216 injected signatures detected exactly, 0 false alarms - no ACC-03/FA-01 claim is made for them beyond that.
